description:
## Objective

Restore Flow compile, Flow run, DSL compile, and deterministic stress measurement.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U7`
Covers: `R1, R2, R7; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.4 (U4) — Port Signal benchmark smoke checks must be complete; jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete; jido-07x.24 (U24) — Generate and enforce the quality report must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.18 (U18) — Reconcile offline AI benchmarks must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_action/test/bench/**` at Action commit `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `test/bench/action_flow/**` and `bench/action_flow/**`. Exclude checked-in result JSON. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port compile, run, DSL probe, and ReAct stress workloads that use current production paths.
2. Store reports under `tmp/bench/action_flow/`.
3. Validate result data and process cleanup before measurement.
4. Keep quick, standard, and stress profiles. Run only quick profiles in smoke tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Quick smoke profiles complete and validate results.
- [ ] Reports include environment and source fingerprint data.
- [ ] No performance threshold fails CI.

## Verification

- `mix test.bench test/bench/action_flow` exits with status `0`, and each quick runner writes one valid report under `tmp/bench/action_flow/`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Port Action and Flow benchmark smoke checks
